# Amuajema Contractors, full site summary

Amuajema Contractors is the public-facing brand of AMUAJEMA LIMITED, a local Tanzanian specialist civil contractor registered with the Contractors Registration Board under SPC3/1273/02/2022. The company is Class 3, Specialist Civil, and based at Plot No. 426 Block D, Nyegezi, Malimbe, Mwanza. Postal address: P.O. Box 110311, Mwanza. Managing Director: Jane Shedaffa. Public contact: +255 754 068 145 and erickfbyn@gmail.com.

Amuajema Contractors delivers building construction, specialist civil works, drainage and external works, renovation and fit-out, maintenance and project support. The company can consider projects across Tanzania based on scope, programme, access and site requirements.

The website explains the company approach, service categories, project types, company standards, contact details and project enquiry process. It does not publish pricing because project costs depend on the site, drawings, quantities, materials, programme and scope.

Source of registration facts: https://www.crb.go.tz/contractordetails/home/show/609
